closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, vitamin K, and omega 3, but the biggest weaknesses are low calcium, low protein quality, and contains anti-nutrients. It's good for immune support, practical meals, and low-calorie volume because vitamin C and vitamin A help support the immune system, it's easy to build meals around, and it helps fill out a meal without many calories.
